title: The Basis of Practical Intellect — Daniel Fox
meta_description: Ego rules an argument out before it is heard, and the result is a working mind with a region fenced off. On functional ignorance, the bet I lost about AI, and what changing your mind actually costs.

schema.headline: The Basis of Practical Intellect
schema.description: Why capable people rule out an argument before hearing it, what that costs, and the reversal that taught the author the same thing about himself.
